desc: Orlivane plant clips are small figure-8 clips for tying vines and stems to stakes, strings and trellises. Loop one end around the plant and the other around the support, and link several clips together for thicker stems. Each clip is about 3 x 3 x 0.6 cm and weighs about 0.6 g. 100 green clips per pack. Reusable season after season.
b: 100 CLIPS PER PACK — 100 green figure-8 vine clips in one bag, enough for a full season of tomatoes, peppers, beans and cucumbers.
EASY TO CLIP ON — Hook one loop around the stem and the other around a stake, string or trellis wire, then press to close.
LINK FOR THICKER STEMS — Join two or more clips together to reach around thicker stems and branches.
SMALL AND LIGHT — Each clip is about 3 x 3 cm (1.2 x 1.2 in) and weighs about 0.6 g, so it holds young vines without crushing them.
REUSABLE — Unclip at the end of the season and use them again next year in the vegetable garden, greenhouse or balcony pots.
kw: plant clips for climbing plants tomato clips trellis clips vine clips garden plant support clips figure 8 cucumber pepper stake clips
